sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: From a point 30 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 16 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
A right triangle has legs 8 and 15 and hypotenuse 17. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 8. Find tan θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has hypotenuse 39 and one leg 15. Find the other leg.
Express sin 47° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 47°, because sine and cosine are always equal
cos 137°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 133°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 43°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.
